output.brief: The Kestria buffering rise is almost certainly caused by the smart-TV app 5.2 release, not the CDN switch. Smart-TV 5.2 sessions stall 5.9% of the time. Every other client, including the 5.1 TV app, web, iOS and Android, stalls 0.6–0.7%. All of these run on the same new CDN, and the pattern is the same across all three ISPs. The stalls began on 9 October, when 5.2 went live, as the CDN cutover finished. The handball launch came later and nothing changed on its match nights. Moving traffic back to Corvane would not fix this, and an SLA notice with withheld fees would punish the wrong party. Do not mute the alert; it is the only warning we have. Next steps: revert the Kestria TV app's adaptive-streaming behaviour to the 5.1 settings and hold the wider 5.2 rollout until the regression is fixed. Add app version and device breakdowns to the dashboard, with an interim manual report until the rebuild. Do not give cancelled subscribers a free month yet. The exit survey has no streaming-quality option, and price is the top answer after the 1 October price rise, so buffering as a cause of cancellations is unproven. Confidence is high on the app being the cause and moderate on the cancellation link.
